servinfo.title: Suspension Arm Joint Dust Cover Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove suspension arm joint dust cover (2) with flat-bladed screwdriver or the like.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Use new suspension arm joint dust cover and new dust cover clip included in dust seal set.
Apply a generous amount of grease included in dust seal set to suspension arm joint and inside of dust cover.
